Fetched on: 2026-08-14

Only the files actually needed by index.html are vendored here
(bundle JS, standalone preset JS, CSS, favicons) — .js.map source
maps, the ES-bundle build variant, and oauth2-redirect.html were
intentionally left out as unused for a read-only viewer with no
OAuth2 flow.
